entries.message: Feature - Expand media discovery and personal media workflows
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Add deterministic Up Next and Discover rails with resilient cached refreshes and richer collection search.
Add personal watchlist, ratings, and custom lists across media pages with canonical episode identity.
Group media-detail maintenance actions in a permanent Tools menu and expose saved-list state in the control bar.
Improve artwork caching, metadata enrichment, syncing, live updates, and dashboard/history presentation.
Refresh frontend architecture, README, in-app route documentation, and the documentation references.
